↑ _World of Warcraft API_

Returns the number of total and online guild members.

```
numTotal , numOnline = GetNumGuildMembers ()
```

## Returns

    numTotal
    number \- Total number of players in the guild, or 0 if not in a guild.
numOnline
    number \- Number of players currently online, or 0 if not in a guild.

## Example

Shows the total headcount of your guild and the number of online and offline people.

```
local numTotal , numOnline = GetNumGuildMembers ()
print ( format ( "%d guild members: %d online, %d offline" , numTotal , numOnline , numTotal - numOnline ))
```

## Details

* You may need to call C\_GuildInfo.GuildRoster() first in order to obtain correct data. May return wrong values immediately after quitting a guild. Maximum returned value is 500.
* This returns values of this API seem to be no longer affected by SetGuildRosterShowOffline )()

## Patch changes

*  **Patch 10.2.0 (2023-11-07):** Removed `numOnlineAndMobileMembers` return value.

Requests updated guild roster information from the server.

```
C_GuildInfo . GuildRoster ()
```

## Details

* GUILD\_ROSTER\_UPDATE fires when updated (but not necessarily altered) information is received from the server.
* The call will be ignored completely if the last GuildRoster() call was less than 10 seconds ago (most likely to limit the traffic caused by frequent opening/closing of the guild tab).

## Patch changes

* Battle for Azeroth **Patch 8.2.0 (2019-06-25):** Moved to `C_GuildInfo.GuildRoster()`
* World of Warcraft **Patch 1.0.0 (2004-10-08):** Added as GuildRoster ()

Sets the show offline guild members flag.

```
SetGuildRosterShowOffline(enabled)
```

    enabled
    boolean \- True includes all guild members; false filters out offline guild members.

* Triggers GUILD\_ROSTER\_UPDATE if filtering mode has changed -- facilitating a customary call to GuildRoster () if this event is registered.

```
-- Fetch updated info when required 
 local f = CreateFrame ( "Frame" ) 
 f : RegisterEvent ( "GUILD_ROSTER_UPDATE" ) 
 f : HookScript ( "OnEvent" , function ( event ) 
	 if ( event == "GUILD_ROSTER_UPDATE" ) then 
		 GuildRoster () 
	 end 
 end )
